description: Discover bookable meeting rooms in the user's organisation via the Graph rooms endpoint (read-only). Returns room resources with displayName, emailAddress, building, floor, capacity, and bookingType — suitable for piping into `create-event` as attendees. Filter by `query` (matches name/email), `building`, `floor`, or minimum `capacity`. Returns empty list on personal accounts (the rooms endpoint is M365-only). Use `outputVerbosity` to control field count.
name: find-meeting-rooms
